author: Diego Sandoval
title: Jeremy Pena left Monday's game with hamstring cramp
desc: Jeremy Pena left Monday's game against the Blue Jays with a right hamstring cramp.
impact: Pena was pulled from Monday's contest after fouling off a pitch in the top of the sixth, and the injury has been revealed as a right hamstring cramp. Fantasy managers can likely breathe a sigh of relief, as Pena should avoid an IL stint as long as it does not worsen in the next day or two.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ali Sanchez (wrist) has X-rays return negative
desc: The X-rays returned negative on Ali Sanchez's wrist injury.
impact: Sanchez is headed for a CT scan. He is day-to-day heading into Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Michael Siani designated for assignment
desc: The Orioles designated Michael Siani for assignment.
impact: Baltimore needed to make room for Chadwick Tromp on its 40-man roster. Siani will head to waivers as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chadwick Tromp has contract selected by Orioles
desc: The Orioles selected the contract of Chadwick Tromp.
impact: Tromp returns as a depth option behind the plate. Michael Siani was designated for assignment as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dalton Rushing leaves game early Monday
desc: Dalton Rushing was removed from Monday's game early against the Twins.
impact: Rushing took a foul tip off him early in the game. There will be an update provided on his status when available.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Kyle Tucker leaves Monday's game with low back spasms
desc: The Dodgers announced that Kyle Tucker left Monday's game against the Twins with low back spasms.
impact: While it is relatively good news compared to the wide range of possible injuries, this is still something to monitor for Tucker in the coming days. More information will likely be revealed on Tuesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sean Manaea to start in doubleheader Wednesday
desc: Sean Manaea will start one of the two games in Wednesday's doubleheader.
impact: Manaea and Nolan McLean will each start one of the two games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nolan McLean to start one of Wednesday doubleheader games
desc: Nolan McLean will start one of the two games in Wednesday's doubleheader for the Mets.
impact: McLean and Sean Manaea will take the mound for the two games. It is unclear who will start which game.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kodai Senga to start Tuesday
desc: Kodai Senga will start on Tuesday against the Mets.
impact: Senga will remain the starter of the first game of the series after Monday's game was postponed. Nolan McLean and Sean Manaea will pitch the two games of Wednesday's doubleheader.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Javier Assad to start in doubleheader Wednesday
desc: Javier Assad will start one of the two games for the Cubs in Wednesday's doubleheader.
impact: Edward Cabrera will remain the starter on Tuesday. Shota Imanaga is starting the other game on Wednesday after Monday's game was postponed.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shota Imanaga to start one of Wednesday's doubleheader games
desc: Shota Imanaga will start one of the two games of Wednesday's doubleheader.
impact: Imanaga was scheduled to start on Sunday and Monday, both of which got postponed. Javier Assad will start the other game of the doubleheader.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Edward Cabrera to remain starter Tuesday
desc: Edward Cabrera will remain the starter in Tuesday's game against the Mets.
impact: Cabrera will make his return from the injured list. Shota Imanaga will start one of Wednesday's doubleheader games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Garrett Crochet (shoulder) not cleared to resume throwing
desc: Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy said Garrett Crochet won't begin throwing yet.
impact: Crochet was re-evaluated on Monday and it showed that he is "improving," but not enough to resume throwing.
